_doc: X Summarizer credibility tiers for the volume-news scorer (v0.3 draft, 2026-10-18; tier enum per SCHEMAS s9 v1.1: T1 T2 T2b T3 T4 T5 / X). c values per Research Bot SPEC s5.1. Handles are matched case-insensitively on username; on day 1 resolve every handle to a numeric user id once (users/by lookup, ~70 user reads ~= $0.70) and match on id thereafter (handles can change). 'verify' = handle not yet confirmed by us; treat as T4/T5 by rule until confirmed.

T1_official.note: Company / exec / issuer accounts. T1 only for the ticker(s) they speak for; on other tickers they are T3.
T1_official.elonmusk_rule: T1 only when the post is about Tesla/SpaceX business (grader relevant=true AND catalyst_type != none); otherwise T4. His volume is huge; never let him fill the 50-post budget (he is excluded from the crowd query, see design s1.4).

T2_news_desks.note: DeItaone/FirstSquawk are our proven fastest wires (4-5 s latency in realtime logs). SemiAnalysis_ is T2 for its own research findings only. 'handles' = already in our follows/logs; 'proposed_additions' = standard desks not yet in our follows (Research Bot SPEC names Reuters/Bloomberg/CNBC/WSJ).

T2b_aggregators.note: v1.1: own tier T2b (credibility_tier='T2b', c=0.6). Fast but re-reporting; is_primary usually false. zerohedge was flagged 'macro noise' for the options pulse but is a first-mover on credit (CoreWeave spreads 10/14). unusual_whales: news headlines here; its flow posts use T3. faststocknewss (119k) seen first-hand in the 10/14 NVDA CUDA-X replay; provisional.

T3_flow_and_analysts.note: Most T3 posts grade as options_flow_chatter or technical_chatter (materiality capped at 1 by the rubric), so they rarely 'explain' a surge alone. TheProfInvestor and MentoviaX are TA-only per HAL-X-ALLOWLIST.

T4_verified_large.rule: verified_type in {business, government} OR (verified_type == blue AND followers >= 10000 AND account_age_days >= 365). Blue check alone is NOT credibility (paid; the 10/16 TSM ring accounts were all blue).

T5_other.thin_rule: followers < 200 AND account_age_days < 180 -> c = 0.075 (thin) Thin stays tier T5 (no sub-tier enum).

zero.when: every dropped item_filter row (any drop_reason: blocklist, ring, promo, spam_cashtags, new_account, low_followers, low_activity, follow_farm, lang, irrelevant_collision)
